author: Codex design90_joint_selection
scope: Personal mechanism design, direct critical-source review, primary literature search and hand derivation only. No model, RTL, Linux, build, board or DeepSeek call.

decision.joint_matching: Do not add a joint matching engine now. Greedy allocation externalities alone are covered by an explicit ordinary page-local/union-footprint allocator or weighted matching when given identical candidate information. No distinct scheduling algorithm was established.
decision.positive_design_boundary: An output-selection hint can be destroyed by the COPY's mandatory source translation, and by irreversible/intervening touches or fills before destination translation. A paid selection point after the source phase can observe the actual remaining useful translation. This is a falsifiable timing/interface capability, not a new hot-first heuristic.
decision.strong_control_required: A pre-source allocator with the source hit/miss and exact current masked-PLRU victim reproduces the minimal no-interference example. Ordinary temporary destination pinning can reproduce even an intervening-touch example. The full-cost, joint V/A comparison must include both.
decision.next_positive_contract: Consider a stable COPY_TO_POOL token whose source, length, pool and tag are immutable at first frontend/backend VALID, while its semantics explicitly leave the destination VPN unbound until before the first real AXI AW. This is a new backend/legalizer contract, not permission to mutate an existing standard COPY after VALID. Use only aligned one-page small copies initially. Normal source translation and actual read happen once; binding uses the paid live resident/free index; normal destination permission and real W/B remain mandatory.

facts: policy_mask_i controls allocation only; tag lookup does not restrict hits by that mask.
A normal hit changes replacement history when !TouchEnable or touch_i is true.
The fill/update edge does not itself change tree history. However this must not be extended to the complete source phase: the wrapper subsequently observes a normal hit on the filled source entry.

With 16 entries and allocation mask 16'h0003, only ways 0 and 1 are eligible. The sole effective two-way decision is tree node 7. Hit on way 0 sets node 7 to 1; hit on way 1 sets it to 0; node 7 equals the chosen victim way within this mask.
No invalid-way preference was found in the reviewed replacement logic; the warm trace therefore deliberately touches each newly filled page to advance the masked victim.

PartitionLocalHistory prevents unrelated background-way touches from modifying node 7; hits on resident protected ways can still modify node 7 even when the current request's DID is a different device.
Production TouchEnable is NonblockEnable and PartitionLocalHistory is PolicyEnable.
The normal masked allocation chooses protected 0x0003 or background 0xfffc by stable main-request DID.
PT completes when iotlb_lu_hit is true; comments explicitly describe successful walk as update and hit. Hence a successful normal source fill is followed by a source-hit touch before COPY continues.
The wrapper performs normal read/write/user/stage permission checks on the content; a resident hint is not authorization.

minimal_native_cache_event_fork.not_claimed: This is a hand derivation using actual replacement equations and a reachable-looking complete COPY sequence. It is not a simulator result and does not prove all wrapper/AXI timing details or software-information privacy.
minimal_native_cache_event_fork.configuration: PolicyEnable=true, NonblockEnable=true, PartitionLocalHistory=true, 16 IOTLB entries; V DID is policy_did_i and allocates mask 0x0003; one-stage fixed 4KiB mappings, non-global PTEs. V context cV and A context cA differ. Sources and destinations have normal required permissions.

addresses.V_candidates: X page + 256 and Y page + 256; each is an exclusive registered 64-byte FREE slot. Source S is a third page + 0, disjoint from all candidate ranges.
addresses.private_warm_regions: X+0, X+128, Y+0, Y+128, each 64 bytes; they are disjoint from X+256/Y+256 and from each other where a single COPY uses them.
addresses.A_current: T+0 -> U+256 or U+320, all 64-byte ranges, in cA/background allocation. Two destination slots are on one U page, both free and disjoint. T and U are warm at release.

original_workload_history: Start from empty relevant IOTLB tags, with the same context-register/map/setup work charged as H_ctx to all cases.
V complete COPY X+0 -> X+128: source X fills way 0, normal source hit and destination hit leave node7=1.
V complete COPY Y+0 -> Y+128: source Y fills way 1, normal source hit and destination hit leave node7=0.

Branch H0: V complete COPY X+0 -> Y+128, both hits, final node7=0. Branch H1: V complete COPY Y+0 -> X+128, both hits, final node7=1. Private outputs are consumed. Candidate X+256/Y+256 remain FREE in both branches and have identical pool allocation/release history.

A complete COPY T+0 -> T+128 and U+0 -> U+128 in cA; normal hits after fills advance background allocation, both keys retained. These background touches do not alter V's local node7. Candidate U+256/U+320 remain FREE.

After this charged history, release current V and current A together. The normalized service construction below serializes complete V then A; this is a legal conservative comparison schedule, not a claim that N cannot overlap them.

current_event_fork.H0: At pre-source choice X and Y both hit. Choose fixed X. V source S misses, fills way 0 and evicts X; subsequent normal hit S sets node7=1. Fixed destination X now misses and fills way1. A post-source choice would instead choose surviving Y and hit.
current_event_fork.H1: X and Y again both hit. Choose fixed X. V source S misses, fills way1 and evicts Y; subsequent source hit S sets node7=0. Fixed destination X remains a hit. A post-source choice chooses X and hits.
current_event_fork.other_tie_break: A fixed Y tie-break swaps which branch loses. Balanced H0/H1 gives one-half extra destination walk for any state-independent tie-break.
current_event_fork.software_information_caveat: H0/H1 differ in actual prior COPY directions. A global software predictor with exact request/touch history can infer node7 and match the survivor choice. Identical candidate free-list observations do not prove that all software observations are identical. Do not use this trace as an impossibility proof against informed software.

complete_normalized_hand_derivation.units: Serialized service units only, not native measured cycles. All variants start before the charged common history. No cache snapshot injection.

assumptions.D_breakdown: 2 normal endpoint lookup/check units + AR1 + R8 + AW1 + W8 + B1 + frontend3 for each real 64-byte COPY on a 64-bit data path.
assumptions.M_meaning: Extra serial cold-endpoint service including all required PTE requests/returns and refill-to-normal-hit overhead; actual native M must replace this assumption.
assumptions.common_pool_overhead_meaning: One atomic reserve/commit and one chosen-slot completion/read; applied to both current V and A for every allocation strategy.
assumptions.early_hot_first_extra_meaning: Two serial no-touch destination hints; total V extra 4.
assumptions.source_first_extra_meaning: Two destination hints after the source phase plus two paid prepare/continuation transport service units; total V extra 6. The successful source translation is consumed once under a NEW paid continuation contract.
assumptions.victim_aware_extra_meaning: Two destination hints plus one source hit/miss hint, with a paid current-victim sideband whose combinational cost is separately counted; total V extra 5 in this arithmetic. If sideband or snapshot arbitration adds a service unit, use 6 instead.
assumptions.pin_extra_meaning: Illustrative one selected-hot lookup, with the atomic allocation edge also acquiring a destination-way lock, total V extra 3. Added pin state, release logic and any contended service are separately charged; this is an explicit new ordinary control, not existing native functionality.
assumptions.history: Five actual warm COPYs, each D24; four cold source endpoints M20. H=200+H_ctx, identical in both branches and all variants. H_ctx includes setup, DDT/PDT/context-cold work and is not assumed free.
assumptions.A_current: One real COPY with both normal endpoints hot, D24 plus common pool overhead2 => 26 units.

rows_release_relative.policy: pre-source hot-first with two no-touch hints
paid source-first normal prepare then late allocator
pre-source exact victim-aware allocator, no intervening protected hits/fills
ordinary temporary hot-destination pin, if assumed pin cost holds

complete_normalized_hand_derivation.from_original_start: Add 200+H_ctx to every listed V/A completion. The active-job release-relative mean makespans are respectively 82,84,76,75,73. The source-first 58->50 and 84->76 improvement is a counterexample to blind current-hot selection, not a superiority claim against victim prediction/pinning.
complete_normalized_hand_derivation.all_physical_work: Seven complete COPYs from original start: five warm-history and two current. Exactly fourteen successful endpoint permissions, seven AR, fifty-six 64-bit R beats, seven AW, fifty-six W beats, seven B and seven actual completion events. Five cold endpoint walks in source-first/victim/pin; an extra cold walk in the losing early branch. No unchosen candidate performs payload work; no source permission is inferred.
complete_normalized_hand_derivation.joint_evaluation_limit: Both V and A completion are shown, but serialization is an assumed service scenario. A real concurrent N comparison must allow legal overlap, count probe/pin interference and use each policy's own isolation runs before claiming fairness/slowdown or tail benefits.

necessary_semantics: The standard native frontend publishes the entire parent COPY at first VALID. Source-first before that point therefore needs a separate normal READ prepare interface and successful continuation ownership; this is not an existing free path.
The source permission result must be consumed once by the same immutable source/length/context/epoch, or ordinary source translation must run again and its lookup/walk cost must be included.
Only after reserve/candidate choice is frozen may standard parent VALID be published. Chosen destination then uses the unchanged normal WRITE permission path.

A prepare failure must report without payload or premature slot reuse. Invalidation, remapping and permission revocation require a specified continuation/drain contract; fixed pinned mappings are the first restricted scope.

reference_incremental_bits.not_total_area: This 245-bit-per-frontend example is a field subset. Native immutable parent source/options/length can be referenced but their lifetime cannot be free. Queue capacity, result ownership/routing, arbitration, failure/drain, bus/register wiring, spills, ports and any pinned translation state are additional. Give an ordinary source-first prepare allocator identical ticket/state budget.

strong_counter_and_adjacent_neighbors.case: No interfering protected touches/fills after the pre-source sample
strong_counter_and_adjacent_neighbors.result: Current source-miss plus exact masked victim predicts the survivor. It reproduces all source-first walk reduction and can have lower overhead. Therefore mandatory-source eviction by itself cannot support an independent post-source mechanism.

strong_counter_and_adjacent_neighbors.case: V cold-S walk is active while N lets A complete a COPY X+0->X+128 or Y+0->Y+128 with normal hot permission hits in the same PSCID/stage context; A has its own DID and non-overlapping private regions
strong_counter_and_adjacent_neighbors.result: Those protected-way hits can flip node7 before V's source fill even though A's allocation mask is background. A current-victim prediction sampled before A arrival can become wrong; a post-source selector observes the actual surviving entry. Full concurrent COPY reachability, exact N gates and data timing remain to be checked; do not claim this is already reproduced.
strong_counter_and_adjacent_neighbors.ordinary_control: Temporary pin of the already chosen destination forces the source fill to the other eligible way and reproduces one-walk V. Compare both V/A; if the pin delays other tasks or reduces usable capacity, that is measured cost, not assumed disqualification.

strong_counter_and_adjacent_neighbors.case: All candidates cold or only one legal/free candidate
strong_counter_and_adjacent_neighbors.result: Late selection cannot avoid the destination walk; overhead loses. Use immediate ordinary fallback.

strong_counter_and_adjacent_neighbors.case: Source already warm and its known touch does not evict any candidate
strong_counter_and_adjacent_neighbors.result: Pre-source fresh hit selection is already sufficient. Post-source interface has no information benefit unless an actual intervening event changes residency.

strong_counter_and_adjacent_neighbors.case: Destination co-resides with source or another mandatory source on a legal non-overlapping range
strong_counter_and_adjacent_neighbors.result: Ordinary source/destination page-local allocation or a union-of-source-footprint allocator can exploit it without PLRU knowledge. Do not claim this alone as new.

strong_counter_and_adjacent_neighbors.case: Source-first prepare needs to repeat a source translation or loses the prepared source entry
strong_counter_and_adjacent_neighbors.result: Charge repeated normal lookup/walk and the continuation cost. A free PA voucher or an assumption that stale authorization remains valid would invalidate the arithmetic.

strong_counter_and_adjacent_neighbors.case: Pinning covers a hot destination while a third task needs that way or asks for another translation
strong_counter_and_adjacent_neighbors.result: Pin may increase that task's real cold walks/wait or force legal bypass; late selection may then lie on a better joint frontier. This is a positive falsifiable design question, not an established advantage. Existing cache reservation/locking methods must receive the same resource budget.

symbolic_destination_token_redesign.added_capability: A request may commit a fixed source and an output-pool identity without choosing a concrete output VPN. Selection can occur after source permission and actual R delivery, when the hardware knows live output-slot ownership and translation state. Standard immutable-address COPY cannot take this action after parent VALID.
symbolic_destination_token_redesign.first_scope: Only cache-line-aligned 64-byte copies with all candidate destinations having the same low-address alignment and no 4KiB crossing; exclusive static pool, fixed mappings, source/each possible destination disjoint, consumers accept returned slot. No MMIO, fixed output pointer or uncounted finishing copy.
state_machine: ACCEPT_TOKEN: first VALID carries immutable src,len,pool,tag and explicit unbound-destination semantics. Reserve completion capacity and sufficient registered payload capacity; do not reserve a concrete slot yet.

READ: source follows normal IOMMU READ permission, real AR/R. No duplicate source prepare or inferred permission. Keep returned bytes in an explicitly priced native buffer reservation if integration permits, otherwise a newly counted buffer.

BIND: before any real destination AW VALID, consult the paid event-maintained resident/free index, atomically claim a legal slot with matching context and geometry; no indefinite hot wait, bounded age/fallback. Freeze its concrete address before AW VALID.

WRITE: chosen destination follows normal IOMMU WRITE permission and real W/B; AW address stays stable whenever VALID&&!READY. Error paths legally finish issued AXI, quarantine/release/report as specified.
COMPLETE: report actual chosen slot/tag/status only after real success, keep consumer ownership until its generation-matching release.
costs_to_price: Native legalizer currently consumes a concrete source/destination parent. New token kind and one-page geometry override are required; not a wire-only change.

Reference phase/pool/selected-slot/source-ready/destination-bound fields add 3+2+6+1+1=13 bits per parent, before actual interface/tag/error/state/return routing. Existing concrete destination field may be reused only after binding under the new datatype contract.

A 64-byte payload occupies eight 64-bit words throughout any output-selection wait. Four such parents require thirty-two words; this consumes actual existing storage if legally connected, not additional free capacity. Native backend FIFO/TCW/extra buffers and ownership routing must be identified before saying no new payload memory.

A blocked or empty output pool can retain source bytes and prevent other useful work. Admission must limit retained bytes, reserve completion independently and bound the wait/fallback; waiting for hot slots is not free.
Keep all registered-pool ownership/index/consumer release/cache synchronization costs from root's L ledger; 13 bits is only the new phase subset.
simple_strong_controls: Same stable-token backend with ordinary page-local/LIFO allocator at the same late point: isolates the resident/free index contribution from late binding itself.
Normal source-first prepare plus late ordinary allocator, all state and transport priced, no artificial duplicate source walk.
Pre-source current victim-aware selection with committed-inflight fill/touch information actually available, and temporary pinning until normal destination permission.
Same resource ordinary larger IOTLB, full permissions in advance with retention, and existing legal outstanding/data buffering.
symbolic_destination_token_redesign.quantitative_gate: Let p be the probability the best pre-source victim/pin policy makes an avoidable cold destination after the actual source/read interval, M_u its unhidden end-to-end cost, and delta the complete token/index/buffering cost minus that policy. Only if p*M_u > delta and the concurrent other DMA is no worse on the selected joint frontier is there a useful region. This gate is ordinary expected-cost arithmetic, not an algorithmic novelty claim.
symbolic_destination_token_redesign.shortest_decisive_question: Can the token be legally integrated at the real write decision point using existing buffer ownership, and is there a legal N/intervening-touch case where fresh late selection beats same-budget victim prediction AND ordinary temporary pinning on V/A completed-copy frontier? If yes, run that one original-start trace and its no-interference/one-free neighbor; otherwise keep the root low-cost resident-free index at pre-COUNT and stop the phase rewrite.

root_ownership_release_design_addendum.attribution: Root independently proposed this stronger ownership-change case; this agent supplied the bounded hand accounting and controls.
root_ownership_release_design_addendum.original_condition: At the original current-job release, A has a legitimately reserved output slot Z and will finish a real COPY Y->Z; V's source S is cold and its acceptable output pool contains free cold X and currently A-owned Z. Do not describe Z as already consumer-owned and overwrite it: ownership must be A's outstanding operation until real completion, then the consumer until sync/consume/release.
root_ownership_release_design_addendum.cache_condition: Y and Z are initially warm in the same legal translation context. A's ordinary final destination hit leaves Z recent. S's later protected-mask source fill evicts Y and leaves Z resident. The required mask/context configuration and complete original-start warming need direct downstream verification; no arbitrary insertion is allowed.
root_ownership_release_design_addendum.positive_action: V initially acquires a capacity credit backed by free X, without committing a concrete payload destination. It performs the source's normal walk and read while A makes progress and its consumer releases Z. Atomic final selection transfers the capacity reservation from X to Z before real AW and leaves X free. Without capacity credit, an adversary could take every output slot while V retains payload; that deadlock/backpressure risk must be priced.

two_resource_hand_case.units: Illustrative request service and non-occupying memory-response latency; not a native trace or measured cycles.
two_resource_hand_case.source_walk: Three serial PTE levels, each AR1 + memory wait10 + R1 = 12, plus normal initial miss1 and normal refill-hit1 => source grant38. The waits do not occupy the data service resource; all six PTE busbeats remain charged.
two_resource_hand_case.A: A hot 64-byte COPY takes about 26 including normal permissions, AR/R8/AW/W8/B and actual completion. Consumer actually accesses the 64-byte output and synchronizes/releases over another charged 11 units, giving Z FREE at about t37. Real CPU cache/sync and release costs can be larger.
two_resource_hand_case.V_pool_token: capacity reservation1 + normal source38 + actual AR/R9 + late bind1 + normal WRITE/AW/W8/B11 + completion report1 = 61. Source grant occurs near39 and actual read completes near48, so the charged release near37 precedes binding. Real contention must be scheduled, not assumed absent.
two_resource_hand_case.wait_until_Z_free: Release delay37 + reserve1 + source38 + AR/R9 + WRITE/AW/W8/B11 + report1 = 97 in the same simplified sequential policy. Legal write-permission overlap can lower this; compare its best achievable schedule rather than force this ordering.
two_resource_hand_case.early_free_X: It needs both cold S and cold X permissions. A destination walk can overlap the nine-unit source data read once the single source walk finishes; therefore the extra38 cannot be claimed entirely as critical-path benefit. An approximate excess is38-9=29 before actual arbitration and binding deltas. The downstream schedule must use all native outstanding capacity and normal N overlap.
two_resource_hand_case.strong_source_prefetch: An independent normal source prepare starts immediately; source ready around38, Z release around37, then late ordinary allocator selects Z. It needs no cold destination walk and can match or beat token61 depending on continuation, parent issue, repeated source lookup and early WRITE preparation. A stateful PA continuation is not free, but neither may it be artificially prohibited or charged twice.
two_resource_hand_case.meaning: This case demonstrates why waiting for a usable endpoint can overlap unavoidable source work. It does not establish token superiority over source preparation. A useful contribution requires a full-cost lower interface/buffer cost or a joint end-to-end region that the simple source-prefetch policy cannot reproduce.

adjacent_counter: If Z is released only after the token's payload buffer fills or is never released, token consumes real payload/credit capacity and can lose or stall; reserve X must permit a bounded ordinary fallback.
If Z is free and warm at arrival, cheap early allocator/pinning already suffices; token adds no information benefit.
If A uses a different PSCID/stage mapping, physical Z warmth does not imply V has a matching translation; both contexts must obtain their own normal permissions.
If S fill or another inevitable normal request evicts Z after release, the late selector must observe that or fall back; no guaranteed warm endpoint remains.

If independent source prefetch has a native cheap continuation and identical storage, it can reproduce the useful action at equal/lower full cost; stop a separate algorithm claim and report only the interface engineering point if any.

prior_work_checked.title: Overcoming the IOTLB wall for multi-100-Gbps Linux-based networking
prior_work_checked.review_scope: Primary full text returned targeted passages on request-pattern control, allocator locality, hugepage-aware allocator, recycled-buffer shuffling, runtime allocation and future locality improvements. Existing locality-aware allocation and its software cost must be controls. These passages do not establish or refute exact source-phase-dependent late symbolic destination selection.

prior_work_checked.title: Efficient Intra-Operating System Protection Against Harmful DMAs
prior_work_checked.review_scope: Primary indexed passages on IOVA allocator safety/performance and locality. This is a new nearest-prior lead, not a complete mechanism review. Do not infer novelty from a search miss.

prior_work_checked.title: io_uring_prep_provide_buffers manual
prior_work_checked.review_scope: Use root round02 original-source verification for provided-group selection and returned buffer ID. A stable pool token or late selection API by itself is not new.

innovation_judgments.joint_algorithm: Because ordinary matching/union-footprint allocation reproduces the relevant group choice when given identical information, do not claim a new joint assignment algorithm from such a hand case.
innovation_judgments.mandatory_source_eviction: Because exact current masked victim prediction reproduces the two-way no-interference fork, that fork supports an interface hazard and a required control, not an independent late-selection contribution.
innovation_judgments.conditional_mechanism: If the new stable-token/late-binding contract plus low-cost real translation/free-slot index exploits a reachable intervening-source/read condition, improves the complete V/A frontier over current-victim prediction, temporary pinning and same-budget ordinary late allocation, and exact nearest work does not cover that integration, it can support an independent mechanism contribution. No such full-cost result is claimed in this artifact.
innovation_judgments.implementation: Potentially feasible as a restricted single-page backend contract, but source/destination legalizer geometry, payload ownership, faults and completion reserve are critical new work. Do not describe this as already present in the native RTL.

recommended_root_action: Use this fork to strengthen the root selector: source-aware/current-victim exclusion is a cheap baseline before any source-first rewrite. Keep the low-cost resident/free index as the main engineering hypothesis. Preserve the symbolic-destination-token contract as a bounded positive design option; decide it using one exact native intervening-touch trace versus ordinary pinning, not a broad new simulator or batch matrix.
